GoalFields.description:
A goal: a bound on an attribute, per day or over the plan. At least
one of `min` and `max` is given. `importance` (1-5) is how much a Prefer
goal weighs; a Must goal keeps its own. `zero_reference` is given exactly
when a bound is 0 and a soft penalty is made from it (the library's
rule, `translate.needs_zero_reference`) and is dropped otherwise.
GoalFields.title: GoalFields

Minimum.description:
The fewest meals a day may serve. A day without one serves all its
planned meals ("at least: all").
Minimum.title: Minimum

PlanResult.description:
One plan in full. Totals are the library's, rounded to each
attribute's decimals; an average is the plan's total over its days.
PlanResult.title: PlanResult

PlanResultSummary.description: A plan without its days, for the cards on A1. Times are UTC.
PlanResultSummary.title: PlanResultSummary

ResultItem.description: An ingredient scaled to the meal's portion, in its unit.
ResultItem.title: ResultItem

ResultMeal.description:
A meal of a day. Not planned (no recipe, portion, totals or items)
when skipped in the schedule or left out by the planner.
ResultMeal.title: ResultMeal

Skip.description: A skipped cell. `meal` is the meal's position in `meals`.
Skip.title: Skip

SolveId.description: Which solve a request is about.
SolveId.title: SolveId

SolveOutcome.description: The new unsaved plan, or why there is none.
SolveOutcome.title: SolveOutcome

TodayPlan.description: The plan used for `date` and that day's meals; `day` is from 0.
TodayPlan.title: TodayPlan
